# Rust Conventions

Read the referenced body when its title applies. Global conventions also apply.
Tool configuration and the research/disposition report are not extra prose rules.

<!-- BEGIN_TABLE: generated by scripts/generate-conventions-index.py, edits inside will be overwritten -->

| Convention | File |
| --- | --- |
| Keep started external work and its capacity owned beyond a cancelled waiter; cancellation is not evidence that an effect stopped. | [async-effect-ownership](../conventions/rust/async-effect-ownership.md) |
| When shared behavior changes, check every supported implementation's owned contract while keeping provider-specific translation local. | [backend-contract-parity](../conventions/rust/backend-contract-parity.md) |
| Bound blocking work by its physical lifetime, because timing out or aborting a waiter does not stop a started blocking closure. | [blocking-work-ownership](../conventions/rust/blocking-work-ownership.md) |
| Tie acknowledgement and capacity release to the owned acceptance contract; overload must not silently discard accepted work. | [bounded-admission](../conventions/rust/bounded-admission.md) |
| Repositories own complete database-only transactions; external preparation or effects cross them through explicit revalidated intent and results. | [completed-persistence-operations](../conventions/rust/completed-persistence-operations.md) |
| Let the composition owner supply collaborators with the operation's required authority; introduce traits for real substitution boundaries. | [composition-owned-collaborators](../conventions/rust/composition-owned-collaborators.md) |
| Expose the consumer's owned contract at a crate boundary, not a live implementation handle or accidental internal layout. | [consumer-owned-api-boundaries](../conventions/rust/consumer-owned-api-boundaries.md) |
| Treat persisted representations and applied migrations as historical contracts; preserve data and invariants in every supported database. | [durable-evolution](../conventions/rust/durable-evolution.md) |
| Let one handling boundary own incident reporting and deliberately choose which error context may cross logs or public responses. | [error-disclosure-ownership](../conventions/rust/error-disclosure-ownership.md) |
| When completion includes asynchronous or fallible cleanup, await an explicit finish and preserve both primary and cleanup failures. | [fallible-resource-shutdown](../conventions/rust/fallible-resource-shutdown.md) |
| When primitive values carry different authority, validation or units, preserve those distinctions in the owning domain contract. | [invariant-bearing-values](../conventions/rust/invariant-bearing-values.md) |
| Choose synchronization around the protected invariant and resource owner, not around an entire service merely to share it. | [invariant-scoped-synchronization](../conventions/rust/invariant-scoped-synchronization.md) |
| Preserve expected rejection, absence, operational failure and unknown physical outcomes instead of collapsing them into one fallback. | [outcome-and-error-meaning](../conventions/rust/outcome-and-error-meaning.md) |
| Before effects, bind an owner to one coherent validated runtime configuration; explicit malformed input does not authorize borrowing another source. | [runtime-configuration-snapshots](../conventions/rust/runtime-configuration-snapshots.md) |
| Model outcomes with different legal next actions as state-specific data; keep genuinely independent observations independent. | [semantic-state-alternatives](../conventions/rust/semantic-state-alternatives.md) |
| Choose time from the contract's authority and units: durable acceptance timestamps and process-relative deadlines are different values. | [time-authority-and-units](../conventions/rust/time-authority-and-units.md) |

<!-- END_TABLE -->
